Match the stages of fetal hair development (Lanugo, Vellus, Terminal) with their descriptions.
options: Lanugo - fine, downy, unpigmented, last 3 months of fetal development
Vellus - fine, unpigmented, at birth, not on scalp or eyes, composes all of childhood hair
Terminal - longer, coarser, pigmented on scalp; replaces axillary and pubic hair in puberty

Match the components of keratohyalin granules.
options: Keratin - protects from mechanical stress and governs cell activity
Profilaggrin - splits into 10-12 versions of the final protein. Coded by FLG gene
Trichohyalin - functions in keratin intermediate filament cross-linking; codes for TCHH gene
Loricrin - 70% of cornified envelope; works alongside involucrin, elafin, keratin, filaggrin

questionInfo.question: What does the TCHH gene determine?
